name: PlainSv
description: Accessible Svelte 5 components, utilities, and Vite plugins written with runes, scoped styles, and native elements, using shadcn design tokens and as few packages as possible.

items.name: init-project
items.description: The package.json, tsconfig, and global types that every init item writes first, before it installs any package.

items.name: init-project-cloudflare
items.description: The package.json, tsconfig, and global types for Cloudflare Workers, with Wrangler scripts and platform types, that init-cloudflare writes first.

items.name: init-base
items.description: The shared PlainSv app shell with app.html, git, npm, Prettier, and VS Code settings, the app context, layout, home and about pages, and page meta, used by every init item.

items.name: init
items.description: A starter SvelteKit app with the auto adapter, the PlainSv theme, app context, dark mode, layout, and page meta, that picks its deploy target at build time.

items.name: init-node
items.description: A starter SvelteKit app on the Node adapter with the PlainSv theme, app context, dark mode, layout, and page meta, rendered on a Node server.

items.name: init-bun
items.description: A starter SvelteKit app on the Bun adapter with the PlainSv theme, app context, dark mode, layout, and page meta, rendered on a Bun server.

items.name: init-vercel
items.description: A starter SvelteKit app on the Vercel adapter with the PlainSv theme, app context, dark mode, layout, and page meta, rendered on Vercel functions.

items.name: init-cloudflare
items.description: A starter SvelteKit app on the Cloudflare adapter with the PlainSv theme, app context, dark mode, layout, and page meta, rendered on Cloudflare Workers.

items.name: init-static
items.description: A starter SvelteKit app on the static adapter with the PlainSv theme, app context, dark mode, layout, and page meta, prerendered at build time.

items.name: init-existing
items.description: The PlainSv styles and global types for an existing SvelteKit project, so components can be added one at a time.

items.name: styles
items.description: The PlainSv theme tokens, resets, CSS utilities, and typeset styles that every component reads.

items.name: button
items.description: A button that triggers an action or renders as a link, with variants, sizes, and rounded corners.

items.name: code-block
items.description: A syntax highlighted code block with a file label header and a copy button, powered by Shiki.

items.name: image-viewer
items.description: A full-screen image preview dialog with optional title editing and removal.

items.name: alert
items.description: A callout for important messages with an optional icon, a title, a description, and an action.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.description: A trail of links to the current page, with custom separators, collapsed items, and sizes.

items.name: calendar
items.description: A date picker grid with single, multiple, and range selection, several months, month and year dropdowns, and keyboard support.

items.name: card
items.description: A container for grouped content with a header, title, description, action, content, and footer, that can render as a link.

items.name: input
items.description: A text field with sizes, rounded corners, file picking, and focus, invalid, and disabled states.

items.name: input-otp
items.description: A one-time code field with joined slots, separators, pattern filtering, paste support, and sizes.

items.name: textarea
items.description: A multi-line text field that grows with its content, with sizes, rounded corners, and focus, invalid, and disabled states.

items.name: label
items.description: An accessible caption for a form control, with sizes, icons, and a dimmed disabled state.

items.name: dialog
items.description: A modal window built on the native dialog element, with a trigger and a content panel.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.description: A modal that interrupts the user to confirm an important action, built on the native dialog element.

items.name: sheet
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge of the screen, built on the native dialog element.

items.name: accordion
items.description: A stack of headings that each reveal a section of content, with single or multiple open items, keyboard support, variants, sizes, and rounded corners.

items.name: ai-action
items.description: One step of an AI response with an icon, a shimmering status title, and details that expand below it.

items.name: message
items.description: A chat message with an avatar, a content bubble, and actions, aligned by who sent it.

items.name: svdown
items.description: Renders streamed Markdown from an AI response, with plan, thinking, and files blocks, code blocks, and safe links.

items.name: questionnaire
items.description: A multi-step questionnaire with single-choice, multiple-choice, freeform, and skippable questions.

items.name: prompt-input
items.description: A chat prompt box with an auto-growing textarea, attached images, a model picker, and a send button.

items.name: collapsible
items.description: A trigger that shows and hides a section of content, with a slide animation and a custom trigger snippet.

items.name: popover
items.description: Rich content in a panel opened from a button, with a header, keyboard and focus support, sizes, and rounded corners.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.description: A menu of actions opened from a button, with groups, checkbox and radio items, submenus, keyboard support, sizes, and rounded corners.

items.name: avatar
items.description: An image of a user with a fallback for initials or an icon, with variants, sizes, and rounded corners.

items.name: progress
items.description: A bar that shows how much of a task is complete, with an indeterminate state, variants, sizes, and rounded corners.

items.name: slider
items.description: A draggable control for picking a value or a range, with keyboard support, variants, sizes, and rounded corners.

items.name: spinner
items.description: A spinning indicator that shows something is loading, with variants and sizes.

items.name: switch
items.description: An on and off toggle for a single setting, with variants, sizes, and rounded corners.

items.name: checkbox
items.description: A box that toggles an option on or off, with a mixed state, variants, sizes, and rounded corners.

items.name: skeleton
items.description: A pulsing placeholder that holds the shape of content while it loads, with rounded corners.

items.name: tabs
items.description: Layered panels shown one at a time, with default, outline, ghost, and line variants, vertical orientation, and keyboard support.

items.name: tooltip
items.description: A short label that appears beside an element on hover or keyboard focus, with sides, variants, sizes, and rounded corners.

items.name: select
items.description: A button that opens a list of options to pick one, with groups, keyboard support, form submission, variants, sizes, and rounded corners.

items.name: command
items.description: A searchable list of commands with groups, shortcuts, keyboard navigation, and a dialog for a command menu.

items.name: combobox
items.description: A button that opens a searchable list to pick one option, built from the popover and command components.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.description: A row of site links whose items open panels of more links on hover, click, or the keyboard.

items.name: badge
items.description: A small label for statuses and counts, with variants, sizes, rounded corners, and a link form.

items.name: separator
items.description: A thin horizontal or vertical line that divides content, decorative by default.

items.name: kbd
items.description: A keyboard key or shortcut label, with a group for key combinations and sizes.

items.name: radio-group
items.description: A set of options where only one can be checked, with keyboard support, form submission, and sizes.

items.name: toggle
items.description: A two-state button that stays pressed until clicked again, with default and outline variants and sizes.

items.name: toggle-group
items.description: A set of toggles with single or multiple selection, joined or spaced items, and keyboard support.

items.name: table
items.description: A responsive data table with a header, body, footer, rows, cells, a caption, and sizes.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.description: A box that keeps a width to height ratio as it resizes, with media that covers it.

items.name: fluid-orb
items.description: An animated WebGL orb with a fluid surface, with theme colors, variants, sizes, and speed.

items.name: orbling
items.description: An AI orb with a face that shows what an assistant is doing, such as thinking, reading, typing, working, and asking, drawn with CSS.

items.name: chart
items.description: Bar, line, area, pie, donut, radar, and radial charts drawn with SVG, with theme colors, a tooltip, a legend, and a data table.

items.name: candlestick-chart
items.description: A candlestick chart with trading sessions, a volume pane, VWAP, moving averages, Bollinger bands, price levels, live updates, zoom, and pan.

items.name: file-tree
items.description: A tree of files and folders built from paths, with file icons, selection, highlights, and keyboard navigation.

items.name: native-select
items.description: A native select styled like the input, with a chevron, sizes, rounded corners, and states.

items.name: empty
items.description: An empty state with media, a title, a description, and actions, with an outline variant and sizes.

items.name: button-group
items.description: A row or column of buttons, inputs, and selects joined into one control, with separators and text.

items.name: input-group
items.description: A bordered field that joins an input or textarea with icons, text, and buttons on any side.

items.name: field
items.description: Form field layout with labels, descriptions, errors, fieldsets, separators, and responsive orientation.

items.name: item
items.description: A flexible row with media, a title, a description, and actions, that can render as a link or a list.

items.name: pagination
items.description: Page navigation with previous and next links, page links, ellipses, and a page range helper.

items.name: scroll-area
items.description: A scrolling box with thin themed scrollbars that can be dragged, shown on hover, and sized.

items.name: resizable
items.description: Panels that share a row or column and resize by dragging or with the keyboard.

items.name: hover-card
items.description: A preview card that opens beside a link when the pointer rests on it or it gets keyboard focus.

items.name: drawer
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge and closes by dragging it back, built on the native dialog element.

items.name: toaster
items.description: Stacked toasts with types, promises, actions, and swipe to dismiss, built without dependencies.

items.name: carousel
items.description: Slides that snap one at a time, with buttons, arrow keys, mouse dragging, looping, and several per view.

items.name: context-menu
items.description: A menu that opens at the pointer on right-click, built on the dropdown menu parts.

items.name: menubar
items.description: A bar of menus like a desktop app, with keyboard navigation between menus, built on the dropdown menu parts.

items.name: date-picker
items.description: A button that opens a calendar in a popover to pick a date or a range, with form submission.

items.name: sidebar
items.description: A collapsible app sidebar with groups, menus, sub menus, and icon mode, that becomes a drawer on mobile.

items.name: data-table
items.description: A data table with sorting, filtering, pagination, column visibility, and row selection, built on the table.

items.name: form
items.description: Form state checked by a zod schema, with fields that show their errors and wire up labels and aria attributes.

items.name: package-command
items.description: A command block with a tab for each package manager, built from one command, with a copy button and a synced, remembered choice.

items.name: dashboard-01
items.description: A dashboard with an inset sidebar, stat cards, an interactive chart, and a data table.

items.name: sidebar-01
items.description: A simple sidebar with navigation grouped by section.

items.name: sidebar-02
items.description: A sidebar with collapsible sections.

items.name: sidebar-03
items.description: A sidebar with submenus.

items.name: sidebar-04
items.description: A floating sidebar with submenus.

items.name: sidebar-05
items.description: A sidebar with collapsible submenus.

items.name: sidebar-06
items.description: A sidebar with submenus as dropdowns.

items.name: sidebar-07
items.description: A sidebar that collapses to icons.

items.name: sidebar-08
items.description: An inset sidebar with secondary navigation.

items.name: sidebar-09
items.description: Collapsible nested sidebars.

items.name: sidebar-10
items.description: A sidebar in a popover.

items.name: sidebar-11
items.description: A sidebar with a collapsible file tree.

items.name: sidebar-12
items.description: A sidebar with a calendar.

items.name: sidebar-13
items.description: A sidebar in a dialog.

items.name: sidebar-14
items.description: A sidebar on the right.

items.name: sidebar-15
items.description: A left and right sidebar.

items.name: sidebar-16
items.description: A sidebar with a sticky site header.

items.name: login-01
items.description: A simple login form in a card.

items.name: login-02
items.description: A two column login page with a cover image.

items.name: login-03
items.description: A login card with social logins on a muted background.

items.name: login-04
items.description: A login card split into a form and a cover image.

items.name: login-05
items.description: A simple email login with social logins.

items.name: signup-01
items.description: A simple sign up form in a card.

items.name: signup-02
items.description: A two column sign up page with a cover image.

items.name: signup-03
items.description: A sign up card on a muted background.

items.name: signup-04
items.description: A sign up card split into a form and a cover image.

items.name: signup-05
items.description: A simple email sign up with social sign ups.

items.name: functions
items.description: Type-safe server functions with Zod validation, called from the client through one POST endpoint.

items.name: auth-base
items.description: Shared auth core with cookie sessions, the sign in hook, and sign in routes, used by every auth item.

items.name: auth-google-sqlite
items.description: Google sign in with cookie sessions, storing users and sessions in SQLite through the Drizzle utility.

items.name: auth-google-mongodb
items.description: Google sign in with cookie sessions, storing users and sessions in MongoDB through the MongoDB utility.

items.name: auth-github-sqlite
items.description: GitHub sign in with cookie sessions, storing users and sessions in SQLite through the Drizzle utility.

items.name: auth-github-mongodb
items.description: GitHub sign in with cookie sessions, storing users and sessions in MongoDB through the MongoDB utility.

items.name: drizzle
items.description: A Drizzle ORM client on Node's built-in node:sqlite, with a typed schema and drizzle-kit migrations.

items.name: mongodb
items.description: A typed MongoDB client with Zod collection schemas and generated create, find, update, and delete methods for each collection.

items.name: dev-plugin
items.description: A Vite plugin that optimizes Lucide and Tabler icon imports, generates src/env.ts from .env, and replaces strings in route files during development.

items.name: svx-plugin
items.description: A Vite plugin that turns Markdown .svx pages into Svelte pages with page meta and code blocks.

items.name: svx-plugin-simple
items.description: A Vite plugin that turns Markdown .svx pages into Svelte pages with page meta and plain code blocks.

items.name: deploy
items.description: Deploy a SvelteKit app on Ubuntu with Node.js, pm2, nginx, and Cloudflare, with a deploy script that sets up the domain and keeps the previous release for rollback
